description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'TbAbstractNodeWithFetchTo' for the Thingsboard rule engine, handling message transformation and configuration upgrades related to 'fetchTo' property.

classes.name: TbAbstractNodeWithFetchTo
classes.description: An abstract class for rule engine nodes that handle fetching data to either message data or metadata, with configuration upgrade capabilities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, ensuring 'fetchTo' is set.

methods.name: loadNodeConfiguration
methods.description: Abstract method to load specific node configuration.

methods.name: checkIfEntityIsPresentOrThrow
methods.description: Returns a function that checks if an EntityId is present and throws if not.

methods.name: getMsgDataAsObjectNode
methods.description: Converts message data to an ObjectNode, throws if not an object.

methods.name: enrichMessage
methods.description: Enriches message data or metadata with a KvEntry based on 'fetchTo' setting.

methods.name: transformMessage
methods.description: Transforms message data or metadata based on 'fetchTo' setting.

methods.name: upgradeRuleNodesWithOldPropertyToUseFetchTo
methods.description: Upgrades old configuration to use 'fetchTo' property.

methods.name: upgradeConfigurationToUseFetchTo
methods.description: Replaces old boolean property with 'fetchTo' string property in configuration.
